item.title: Remembering Rev. Jesse Jackson: Services expanded to include Chicago, South Carolina, Washington DC
item.description: Rev. Jesse Jackson's family and the Rainbow PUSH Coalition have released a new schedule of services to remember the late civil rights icon, which now includes Chicago, South Carolina and Washington, D.C.

item.title: Woman randomly punched in the Loop while walking to work, victim speaks out; CPD investigating
item.description: A random attack on a woman in the Loop comes after similar assaults. One of them involved ABC7's very own Leah Hope, which compelled the latest victim to tell her own story.

item.title: Trump says he doesn't know if aliens are real but directs government to release files on UFOs, more
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that he's directing the Pentagon and other government agencies to identify and release files related to extraterrestrials and UFOs because of "tremendous interest."

item.title: Chicago Bears signal shift to Hammond as Indiana committee passes stadium bill
item.description: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker said he was "surprised" after the Chicago Bears signaled a shift to Indiana in a new statement on a potential stadium as Indiana lawmakers moved forward with a bill to bring the team to Hammond.

item.title: Chicago-area couple on the hook for nearly $8K for hearing aid they say didn't work properly
item.description: A Chicago-area couple was on the hook for almost $8,000 in deposits and financing for a hearing aid that they say didn't work properly. The ABC7 I-Team investigated the dispute and uncovering similar complaints about the same company.
